difficulty_reason: The proof unfolds the definition of the pullback of modules (tensor of the inverse image with the structure sheaf), then transports the question to stalks using two standard commutation facts: taking stalks at p (applying p^{-1}) commutes with tensor product (lemma-tensor-product-pullback of this chapter), and the stalk of a pullback at p agrees with the stalk at the image point q = f \circ p (Sites lemmas on points of morphisms of sites and topoi). Assembling these into the displayed identification is the substance; each ingredient is explicitly invoked in the proof lines.
